original.question_en: What was agreed on DCI formats? (DCI format decisions)
original.cypher: MATCH (a:Agreement)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) WHERE a.content CONTAINS 'DCI' AND a.content CONTAINS 'format' RETURN m.meetingNumber, a.resolutionId, a.content ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC LIMIT 10

However an any-subset-at-boundary validator must identify every legal member at the cutoff, otherwise it falsely rejects legitimate alternative tens.
